title: Landing-page bundle content (bundle.json) v1
description: Per-site config (migrated sites.yaml), per-family X1-X5 stacks + slot requirements, and the frozen-component contracts (parent EPIC_PLAN §5). Detailed leaf shapes (site config, component props) are intentionally open pending the P1/P2 migration of mss sites.yaml and component contracts; the skeleton here is the frozen interface.

sites.description: Keyed by canonical SITE id (migrated from mss sites.yaml; Helios is source of truth per decision 3).

families.description: Keyed by family id (e.g. 'weed-delivery-near-me'); the X1-X5 stack and per-slot requirements.

components.description: Frozen component contracts, including the X2 trust-anchor (cash/debit). Keyed by component id.

site.description: Per-site config migrated from sites.yaml. Shape is open in P0; pinned during P1 sites.jsonc migration.

purpose_max_variant.description: Mirror of the mss-owned MAX_VARIANT_BY_PURPOSE drift-guard: PURPOSE -> highest valid NUM. The compiler validates policy/kill-list NUMs against this.

purpose.description: Canonical PURPOSE this family renders under (e.g. deliverance, compare).

slots.description: Ordered X-slot ids that make up this family's stack (e.g. ['X1','X2','X3','X4','X5']).

slot_requirements.description: Per-slot requirements (required?, frozen?, data-driven?). Keyed by slot id.

component.description: A frozen component contract. X2 (trust anchor cash/debit) is the canonical example; frozen components may not be edited without a page-dave -p 4 event (parent §7).

approval_id.description: asset/legal approval id backing this component's provenance.
